rules.rule: Suspected infection (blood cultures and antibiotics) plus a SOFA rise of at least 2: MAP < 70 mmHg, platelets < 150 K/uL, bilirubin ≥ 1.2 mg/dL, creatinine rise from the patient's own low
Creatinine up ≥ 0.3 mg/dL within 48 h, or to ≥ 1.5x an earlier value within 7 days. A stable high baseline (CKD) does not count
Sodium < 135 mmol/L that was clinically significant: treated (fluid restriction, salt tablets, tolvaptan, hypertonic saline) or checked ≥ 4 times in 48 h
Hemoglobin drop ≥ 2 g/dL with a documented bleeding source or a transfusion
At least 2 of: SpO2 < 91% on room air, PaO2 < 60 mmHg, respiratory rate > 28/min; plus oxygen therapy
LVEF ≤ 40%, BNP > 400 pg/mL and an IV loop diuretic
